crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall keep my statutes. “ ‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “ ‘You shall not sow your field…

translations.web: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
translations.bsb: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not wear a mingled stuff, wool and linen together.
